title: Core: AS2 var hoisting and function hoisting
description: Test compilation of AS2 variable and function hoisting behavior: (1) var x declared in block still accessible outside (AS2 uses function scope), (2) function declarations are hoisted to top of scope, (3) var x = 1 in for loop body is hoisted to function scope, (4) nested function declarations, (5) function expression (var fn = function(){}) vs declaration (function fn(){}). Verify ActionDefineFunction2 (0x8E) for declarations.
